jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
אנו מחפשים מנהל/ת אוטומציה / מהנדס/ת מפעל בעל/ת יוזמה ויכולות הובלה, שיצטרף/תצטרף לצוות ההנדסה שלנו. תפקיד זה מהווה הזדמנות ייחודית להשפיע על עתיד הייצור במפעל, תוך כדי הובלת חדשנות ויישום טכנולוגיות מתקדמות של Industry 4.0.
 בתפקיד זה תהיה/תהיי אחראי/ת על תכנון והטמעת מערכות אוטומציה מתקדמות, ניהול פרויקטים מורכבים מול ספקים גלובליים, והבטחת עמידה ביעדי ביצוע הנדסיים. מדובר בתפקיד מאתגר הדורש ראש גדול, נכונות לעבודה מאומצת ונסיעות לחו"ל, ויכולת להוביל שינויים טכנולוגיים משמעותיים.
 תחומי האחריות:
 - תכנון רעיוני של מכונות וקווי ייצור אוטומטיים בהתאם לצורכי המפעל וההרכבות.
- הובלה והטמעת פתרונות אוטומציה ויישומי Industry 4.0.
- ניהול פרויקטים הנדסיים מקצה לקצה, משלב התכנון ועד ליישום ברצפת המפעל.
- התנהלות מול מתכננים וספקים בארץ ובחו"ל, כולל כתיבת מפרטים טכניים.
- קליטה, הטמעה ופיקוח על ביצועי מכונות וטכנולוגיות חדשות במפעל.
- אחריות לקידום חדשנות טכנולוגית ולשיפור מתמיד של תהליכי הייצור.
 הצטרף/הצטרפי אלינו והיה/תהיי חלק מצוות מוביל, המעצב את הדור הבא של תעשיית הייצור וההרכבות.
Requirements:
 - מהנדס/ת מכונות עם לפחות 5-7 שנות ניסיון בתעשייה יצרנית – חובה .
- ניסיון מוכח ב מכניקה , פנאומטיקה , בקרים מתוכנתים (PLCs) , הידראוליקה ו עיבוד שבבי – חובה .
- אנגלית טכנית ברמה גבוהה (כתיבה ודיבור) – חובה .
- יכולת עבודה מול ספקים ושותפים טכנולוגיים בארץ ובחו"ל, כולל כתיבת מפרטים למכונות – יתרון .
- ידע ב אוטומציה , רובוטיקה ו מערכות בקרה – יתרון משמעותי .
- נכונות לנסיעות לחו"ל ולעבודה בשעות מאומצות/לא שגרתיות.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer
 Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
We are looking for smart, sharp, analytical, creative problem solvers industrial engineering who love to plan, work at high pace & have excellent interpersonal relations to join our team and our challenging business environment.
 What’s in it for you?
 By Joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of a big and robust, yet growing and dynamic organization where you will have the ability to influence and make changes at technology company with non-compromised operational excellence standards.
 Our Group: Industrial engineering; Operations division.
 What you'll be doing:
 Industrial engineering in PDC Operations division is responsible for development & analysis of operational processes in order to ensure continuous improvement and organizational efficiency in main operational and financial KPIs, focused on productivity added value to production floor processes.
As part of the role you will get to lead independently various type of challenging projects in order to support line design optimization, cycle time reduction, ROI simulations, definition and implementation of new processes and infrastructures that supports efficient operations in low validity business environment and more.
The role includes high exposure to complex organizational processes and interfaces and requires high interpersonal skills, fast thinking, high independency and ability to lead activities with no formal authority.
 What you should have?
 - BSc in Industrial Engineering or equivalent - must
- >4 years of experience in IE/operational roles
- Experience in project management- must
- Excellent English – speaking, reading and writing - must
- Very good analytical skills, sharp & fast thinking.
- Customer orientation with the ability to influence and motivate internal and external interfaces
- Ability to work under pressure, manage and prioritize multiple tasks in parallel and manage timelines & due dates independently.
- Good verbal skills, ability to present and communicate key messages to management forums.
- Ability to manage long term task & projects in addition to the daily execution.
- Advantage for strong understanding of manufacturing & operational excellence processes.
- Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines
- Knowledge of best practices methods, CI & Lean/Six Sigma expertise- advantage.
 Who we are?
 Applied Materials Israel is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control business unit (PDC). Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture and market cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision-based metrology and inspection products that are essential elements in wafer fabrication. By playing a significant role in enabling the production of the next generation of microchips, our expertise enables our customers to transform possibilities into reality.
 Additional Information
 Time Type:
 Full time
 Employee Type:
 Assignee / Regular
 Travel:
 Relocation Eligible:
 No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Project Manager & Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
MediWound is seeking a Project Manager, Operational Excellence, to lead cross-functional projects, align teams around shared priorities, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. The role combines project management, budget planning and control, implementation of Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and monitoring of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). It also includes leading the adoption of AI tools and administering organizational work platforms, including Claude and monday.com.
 This pivotal, cross-functional role works closely with department heads and directly influences how the organization plans, executes, and learns
 What will you do?
 Project Management
 - Lead cross-functional projects end to end, from initiation and planning through execution, delivery, and closure.
- Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in partnership with department heads and key stakeholders.
- Build and maintain detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and budgets.
- Monitor progress against plan, manage changes to scope and timelines, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
- Provide regular status reports and updates to management and stakeholders.
- Identify risks, dependencies, and roadblocks early, develop mitigation plans, and escalate issues when needed.
- Facilitate project meetings, drive decisions, and hold teams accountable for their commitments.
- Conduct post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and standardize best practices.
 Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
 - Lead operational excellence and process improvement initiatives using recognized methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma.
- Map and analyze current workflows to identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks, and design improved future-state processes.
- Define measurable improvement targets, track results, and ensure that gains are sustained over time.
- Standardize and document improved processes and best practices in coordination with process owners and in alignment with quality and regulatory requirements.
- Promote a culture of continuous improvement by facilitating improvement workshops and training teams on improvement tools.
 Budget Management, OKRs, and Performance Metrics
 - Plan, manage, and monitor project and operational budgets, tracking actual spending against plan and flagging variances.
- Lead the implementation of the OKR framework across the organization, supporting teams in setting objectives and tracking progress against them.
- Define, collect, and analyze departmental KPIs, and build dashboards that track performance over time.
- Lead the quarterly business review process, preparing and presenting an organization-wide update on KPI and OKR performance, project status, key achievements, challenges, and recommended next steps.
 AI Adoption
 - Identify high-value use cases for AI and lead the implementation and adoption of AI tools across the organization.
 Work Management Platform (monday.com)
 - Own the organization's monday.com environment, designing workspaces, boards, and dashboards that give departments and management real-time visibility into projects, tasks, and KPIs.
- Build automations and integrations that streamline workflows and reduce manual work.
- Define platform standards and best practices to ensure consistent use across the organization.
- Train and support users across the organization and drive adoption of the platform.
 What should you have?
 - At least three years of hands-on project management experience, leading cross-functional projects in an operations, Project Management Office (PMO), or similar role.
- Experience working with managers and stakeholders across multiple departments simultaneously.
- Proven knowledge of project management methodologies and tools, including planning, scheduling, and risk management.
- Experience in budget planning and control.
- Working knowledge of OKR frameworks and KPI measurement.
- Advanced proficiency in monday.com or a comparable work management platform, including dashboard development.
- Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including building data-driven presentations for management.
- Familiarity with and interest in AI tools, with a willingness to lead their adoption across the organization.
- Native-level Hebrew and excellent written and verbal English.
 Preferred Qualifications
 - Project management certification, such as PMP.
- Certification or practical experience in Lean methodologies, such as Lean Six Sigma.
- Experience in a biotech, pharmaceutical, or other regulated environment.
- A bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering and management, Business Administration, or a related field.
 Key Competencies
 - Strong organizational skills, a structured approach, and the ability to see the broader organizational picture while maintaining attention to detail.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and engage others without direct authority.
- Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and prioritize effectively.
- Analytical thinking, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and communicate findings clearly.
- Technological curiosity and a willingness to learn and implement new tools.
- Initiative, independence, strong ownership and accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
